app.title: Intelligent Spray — Interactive Demo
app.intro: When a part sits slightly off its fixture, a fixed spray path misses. This demo shows the fix: the camera finds how far the part moved and rotated, and the saved spray path is shifted to match before spraying.
app.storageMemory: This browser blocks local storage (private window?) - recipes and the cycle log are kept only until you close the page. Use Export to keep them.
wiz.stressHint: Applied to the simulated photo in step 2 and to the accuracy test.
wiz.d0: Pick a photo of a correctly placed part. Its outline and spray path are found for you — check them, then save.
wiz.d1: Choose the recipe, then simulate where the part landed in the fixture — or use a real photo.
wiz.t2: Find how far the part moved
wiz.d2: The camera compares this photo with the taught one and moves the spray path to match.
wiz.d3: Watch the paint go on along the corrected path and check the film before the robot runs.
wiz.h0: Pick a photo — the outline is found automatically.
wiz.h1: Load a recipe, then press Randomize or upload a photo.
wiz.h3: Press Play or Show final result.
wiz.h4: Use the simulated after-photo, then press Inspect.
wiz.hDone5: Cycle complete. Start the next part when ready.
setup.heading: Station Setup
setup.intro: Settings for this spray station, shared by every recipe. Saved automatically in this browser.
setup.camRobotHint: Jog the robot tool to 3+ marks visible in the photo and enter both positions. A least-squares fit gives the scale, rotation and axis flip between photo and robot.
setup.calibAligned: Robot alignment active: {mm} mm/px, rotation {rot}°, axis flip: {flip}, fit error {rms} mm RMS. Exports use robot coordinates.
setup.calibScaleOnly: Scale only: {mm} mm/px (no robot alignment - exports use photo axes in mm).
setup.calibFitFailed: Alignment needs at least 3 point pairs that are not on one line.
setup.calibNeedContour: Select a part outline in step 1 first.
setup.calibNeedSize: Enter the real width in mm first.
combine.rolesHint: Outline = the part to spray (also the main feature). Feature = extra region used for matching. Keep-out = never spray (holes are added automatically).
combine.contourEmpty: No contours found yet - click "Find contours".
combine.statusCvLoading: OpenCV.js is still loading, please wait.
combine.statusContoursFound: {count} contour(s) found. The largest is the part outline and its holes are keep-outs - change roles in the list.
combine.statusNoContours: No part outline found - try a lower or higher threshold.
combine.statusPhotoLoaded: Loaded your photo. Click "Find contours" to build the path on it.
combine.statusNeedPath: Find contours and pick a part outline before saving.
combine.statusStorageFull: Saving failed - browser storage may be full. Export and delete old recipes, then try again.
combine.confirmOverwrite: A recipe named "{name}" already exists. Overwrite it?
combine.confirmImportOverwrite: These recipes already exist: {names}. Overwrite them? (Cancel imports only the new ones.)
combine.statusImportFailed: Import failed - that file is not an Intelligent Spray recipe export.
prog.stats: Path {len} m · {points} points · cycle {cycle} s · paint {paint} ml · row spacing {spacing} mm
prog.statsNone: No path yet - find contours and pick a part outline.
prerun.identifyRunning: Matching the current photo against every recipe...
prerun.identifyNeedPhoto: Load a recipe or upload a current photo first.
prerun.identifyNoRecipes: No saved recipes to compare against.
prerun.identifyUnknown: Unknown part - no recipe matched well enough. Do not spray.
prerun.simulateLabel: Simulate the workpiece shifting (ground truth — hidden until you reveal it)
prerun.confirmOverride: The match is outside the station limits. Apply the corrected path anyway? This is recorded in the cycle log.
prerun.featureNoRegion: Recipe has no feature region - matching will fail
prerun.matchRecipeLoaded: Recipe loaded. Shift the part or upload a current photo, then run the match.
prerun.matchSimGenerated: Simulated current photo ready. Next: run the match in step 3 (Align).
prerun.matchUploaded: Uploaded photo ready - no ground truth for a real photo. Run the match.
prerun.cvLoadingInitial: Loading OpenCV.js (WebAssembly, ~10 MB) - this can take a few seconds on first load...
prerun.cvReady: OpenCV.js ready. Load a recipe, shift the part or upload a photo, then run the match.
prerun.matchNoFeatureRegion: This recipe has no feature region.
prerun.matchTooFewFeatures: Not enough distinctive features found - try a more detailed feature region or the template method.
prerun.matchTooFewMatches: Too few good matches ({count}) to compute a reliable transform.
prerun.matchNeedPath: Load a recipe with a spray path first.
prerun.matchRejected: Outside the station limits - path NOT applied. Check the part seating, or override.
prerun.matchOverridden: Override applied - recorded in the cycle log.
prerun.matchConfirmed: Path confirmed with no adjustment - use only when you are certain the workpiece has not moved.
prerun.groundDialedIn: You dialed in: shift ({sx}, {sy}) px, rotate {rot}°, scale {scale} %.
prerun.groundTrueMove: The main feature really moved ({x}, {y}) mm.
prerun.groundError: Position error {e} mm, rotation error {et}°, scale error {es} %.
stress.title: Stress test: lighting, noise, blur, covered feature
bench.title: Accuracy test (run many random shifts)
bench.hint: Moves the part randomly within the slider ranges, runs the match each time and compares it with the true position. Uses the stress settings and matching options currently selected.
corrected.heading: Corrected Path & Spray Simulation
sim.filmLegendHint: Blue = too thin · grey = on target · red = too thick
sim.statusInitial: No corrected path yet — run the match in step 3 (Align).
sim.statusReady: Ready - press Play to simulate the spray pass.
sim.statusRejected: Match rejected — nothing to spray. Re-seat the part, or override in step 3 (Align).
sim.statusTooFew: This path has too few points to simulate.
sim.statusFinished: Spray pass finished - coverage results below.
metric.coveredSub: part area with ≥ 50 % of target film
export.title: Export corrected path
export.frameRobot: Coordinates: robot frame (from the camera → robot alignment), Z = {z} mm.
export.frameImage: Coordinates: photo axes × {mm} mm/px (no robot alignment set), Z = {z} mm.
export.warning: Robot programs are templates: verify tool orientation, frames and I/O on a simulator before running on a real robot.
inspect.judgedSub: where the surface differs enough from the paint colour
inspect.hint: The camera takes a second photo after spraying, from the same position. Paint opacity is measured against the before-photo using the paint colour (Spray › Simulation options), then compared with the planned film.
inspect.fail: FAIL - missed or thin areas, or paint in keep-outs
inspect.missedSub: of the area that should be painted
inspect.statusReady: Spray finished - use the simulated after-photo or upload a real one.
inspect.statusUploaded: Uploaded after-photo ready (must be taken from the same camera position). Click Inspect.
inspect.statusFail: Inspection failed - see the marked areas. Touch up or re-spray.
log.heading: Cycle Log & Trend
log.intro: Every pre-run is logged. A steady drift in the measured offsets usually means the fixture is wearing or has been knocked.
log.empty: No cycles logged yet - run a match.
log.driftSlope: {axis} is drifting {v} {u} per cycle - check the fixture
log.driftOffset: {axis} has a steady offset of {v} {u} - re-teach the fixture or recipe
log.noDrift: No drift in the last {n} measured cycles
log.needMore: {n} measured cycle(s) - drift check needs at least 8
wiz.confirmHint: Only when you are sure the part has not moved: spray the taught path without checking.
wiz.h0save: Check the outline and path, then Save & continue.
log.trendWait: Trend charts appear after {min} measured cycles ({n} so far).
order.intro: The active order decides which part is loaded and counts every finished part. The 3D cell shows its progress.
order.none: No active work order — parts are not counted. Open Work orders to start one.
order.mismatch: The loaded part is not this order's recipe — it is not counted.
order.confirmDelete: Delete order {id}? Its counts are lost (the cycle log keeps the cycles).
order.errRecipe: Save a recipe in step 1 first.
order.errQty: Enter a quantity of at least 1.
cell.hint: Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom
